description: This source file defines API endpoints related to processing EDI 837 files, including single file processing, batch processing, and retrieving job statuses. It uses FastAPI's routing and dependency injection features, interacts with a JobManager to queue and manage background jobs, and imports specific request/response schemas.

methods.name: JobManager get_job_manager()
methods.description: Provides a singleton in-memory instance of JobManager for dependency injection.

methods.name: JobResponse process_file( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, payload: Optional[FileProcessRequest] = Body(None, description="Blob reference payload"), file: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Raw EDI 837 file upload"), allow_overwrite: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Override overwrite behavior for this request"), jobs: JobManager = Depends(get_job_manager), )
methods.description: Handles the API request to process a single EDI 837 file, either from upload or blob reference, queues a background job.

methods.name: JobResponse process_batch( payload: BatchProcessRequest = Body(...), jobs: JobManager = Depends(get_job_manager), )
methods.description: Handles batch processing requests by creating and enqueuing a batch job.

methods.name: JobStatusResponse get_job_status( job_id: str = Path(..., description="The job identifier"), jobs: JobManager = Depends(get_job_manager), )
methods.description: Retrieves status and details of a specific background job by its ID.
